## Salmon size and location

This is table clarify my conceptual map of the smolt and adult migration stages to justify matching the NCC and AK stages with specific other species.

```{r salmon}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(stringr)
library(flextable)
library(ftExtra)

# 1. Define data frame with BibTeX keys
df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Stage,   ~Location, ~Length_mm, ~DistShore_nm,  ~Depth_m,  ~Season,  ~Citation,
  "Smolt",  "NCC" ,     "100-250",  "0-60nm",      "na",     "Spring-summer", "[@teel_genetic_2015;@weitkamp_stock-specific_2015;  @daly_spatial_2012;@daly_ontogenetic_2009]",
  "Smolt",  "WCVI"  ,   "150-300",  "0-60nm",      "122 m",   "Summer",       "[@tucker_life_2011]",
  "Smolt",  "BC/SEAK",  "200-400",  "longitude 125-128",      ">200 m", "Summer-fall-winter", "[@tucker_life_2011]",
  "Immature","BC/SEAK", "350-550",  "longitude 127-135",      "<100 m", "Summer-fall-winter", "[@tucker_life_2011]"
)
# 2. Extract citations automatically for Pandoc
table_citations <- df %>%
  pull(Citation) %>%
  str_extract_all("@[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique() %>%
  paste(collapse = "; ")

# 3. Render table
df %>%
  flextable() %>%
  colformat_md(j = "Citation") %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Stage = "Stage",
    Location = "Location",
    Length_mm = "Length (mm)",
    DistShore_nm ="Distance from shore \n(nautical miles)",
    Depth_m = "Depth (m)",
    Season = "Season",
    Citation = "Referenced Sources"
  ) %>%
  autofit()


```

[r table_citations]{style="display: none;"}
<!-- Hidden citations for Pandoc -->
<span style="display:none">`r table_citations`</span>

## Predatory fish biomass index comparison

```{r predator_ssb_info}
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(ftExtra)

# 1. Define data frame for predator covariates
pred_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~PredatorNode,         ~Index,                                         ~AssessmentSource,            ~L50,                                              ~A50,                              ~Notes,
  "Sablefish",           "2-Year Lag (t-2) on Total Biomass (Age-2+)",   "Goethel et al., Table 3.15",  "Females: ~60-65 cm\n\nMales: ~55-57 cm",          "Females: ~5.5-6 yrs\n\nMales: ~4-5 yrs", "Approximates Age-4+ (>=500 mm benthopelagic field).",
  "Walleye Pollock",     "Spawning Stock Biomass (SSB)",                "Monnahan et al., Table 1.23", "Females: ~42-45 cm",                             "Females: ~4-5 yrs",               "A little small-- maybe lag 1 year? roughly 1:1 sex ratio and similar male/female growth curves",
  "Pacific Halibut",     "Total biomass age 8+",                        "Stewart & Hicks, Table 1",   "Females: ~115-125 cm\n\nMales: ~70-80 cm",        "Females: ~11-12 yrs\n\nMales: ~8 yrs",   "They don't need to be that large (L50) to eat a yearling",
  "Pacific Cod",         "Spawning Stock Biomass (SSB)",                "Hulson et al., Table 2.7",    "Females: ~50-58 cm",                             "Females: ~4.4-4.9 yrs",           "This is our target size",
  "Arrowtooth Flounder", "Female Spawning Biomass (FSB)",               "Shotwell et al., Table 7.16", "Females: ~47-50 cm",                             "Females: ~6-7 yrs",               "This is our target size; Males stay small; FSB isolates large predatory females"
)

# 2. Render table
pred_df %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    PredatorNode = "Predator Node",
    Index = "Index",
    AssessmentSource = "Assessment Source",
    L50 = "Length at 50%\nMaturity (L50)",
    A50 = "Age at 50%\nMaturity (A50)",
    Notes = "Notes"
  ) %>%
  autofit()
```
